17.text: то о̂тдавать ему безо̂тговорочно — билетъ ему заподписаниемъ
17.note: dot over a short rule. probably not worth encoding as something bespoke — the dot is a speck and the rule a plain dash, keyed spaced (the editor, 2026-11-17). билетъ: the print sets ъ, not ь (2×).
